proposals.rationale: Add companion exception for 'except during use' which relieves the employer of the requirement to keep portable fire extinguishers in their designated places at all times while they are being used, qualifying baseline rule C0001.

context_quotes: (4) The employer shall assure that portable fire extinguishers are maintained in a fully charged and operable condition and kept in their designated places at all times except during use.
